newsitem.title: USA: McKesson in prime vendor pact.
newsitem.headline: McKesson in prime vendor pact.

text.p: McKesson Corp said Tuesday its U.S. Health Care unit has signed an exclusive prime-vendor agreement with ShopKo Stores Inc.
The five-year pact, effective November 16, is expected to result in sales to ShopKo totaling $1.1 billion over the term of the contract, McKesson said in a statement.
McKesson said that the pending merger between ShopKo and Phar-Mor Inc could raise potential sales under the contract to as much as $2.15 billion.
McKesson will provide pharmaceuticals and related items to all 130 ShopKo pharmacies. McKesson has annual revenues of $14 billion.
ShopKo operates 130 stores in 15 states concentrated in the upper Midwest, Mountain and Pacific areas.
